instruction: Open /home/user/Desktop/housing.step and /home/user/Desktop/tool.step in BRL-CAD. Place the 50 x 25 x 20 mm tool solid inside the 90 x 50 x 30 mm housing so their centers coincide, subtract the tool from the housing, and add a top center cylindrical boss of diameter 20 mm and height 8 mm. Save the completed STL mesh as /home/user/Desktop/out.stl. [Software] Run `mged` from a terminal (use the full path if it is not on PATH). Before starting the work, BRL-CAD's main editor is `/usr/brlcad/bin/mged`; its conversion and rendering tools are under the same `/usr/brlcad/bin` directory when working on `housing.step`.
